import { useMessage } from '@src/utils/useMessage';
import App from '@src/response-apps/guildSecretRealmWar/list/app';
import { selects } from '@src/response/config';
import { FormatGui } from '@src/utils/messageHelper';
import { Format, onResponse } from 'alemonjs';
export default onResponse(selects, async e => {
  const text = (e.MessageText || '').trim();
  const m = text.match(/^[!！/#＃]?灵脉攻防战列表\s*(\d+)?\s*$/);

  if (!m) {
    return;
  }
  const [message] = useMessage();
  const bid = e?.UserId;
  const result = await App({ bid, page: Number(m[1] || 1) });
  const md = Format.createMarkdown();

  if (result.code !== 'OK') {
    md.addText(result.data.message);
  } else {
    for (const item of result.data.items as Array<Record<string, unknown>>) {
      const winner = typeof item.winnerGuildName === 'string' && item.winnerGuildName.length > 0 ? item.winnerGuildName : '无人占领';
      const points = typeof item.winnerPoints === 'number' ? item.winnerPoints : 0;

      md.addText(`【${item.realmNo}】${item.name}（${item.tier}）\n领先：${winner} ${points}分\n查看：/灵脉攻防战查看 ${item.realmNo} 1\n`);
    }
  }
  void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate: e.isPrivate ?? false, bid, title: '灵脉攻防战列表', content: md, footer: [{ label: '返回', command: '/灵脉攻防战' }] }));
});
